resources.string: Is it fast enough to play?
Turn the left stick in circles for 10 seconds.
Great for games: a signal every %1$d ms.
Playable: a signal every %1$d ms. Fast games may feel a little late.
Slow: a signal every %1$d ms and %2$d pauses. A wired controller, or the controller closer to the TV, helps.
The controller did not move. Try again and keep turning the stick.
